title: SI10-2 is a single path-integral framework Z = ∫D[x]D[h_mn]exp(iS/ħ) that unifies quantum mechanics and gravity from five axioms on a fixed flat Minkowski background, with no free parameters. The tensor field h_mn is postulated as a massless symmetric rank-2 tensor (same starting point as Feynman 1963, Weinberg 1964, Deser 1970); Axioms 4 and 5 then show it must be the Fierz-Pauli spin-2 field. Three quantities standard QM inserts by hand are derived: V=mgz, the Equivalence Principle, and the mass-dependent gravitational phase. All match experiment without curve fitting: qBOUNCE energy levels (0.03σ), COW phase (0.03%), MICROSCOPE EP test (|η|<1.5×10⁻¹⁵), Fermi-LAT ξ=0. The Deser bootstrap extends the theory to the full Einstein equation, recovering Mercury precession (0.26σ), light deflection (0.60σ), gravitational wave chirp rate, tensor polarisation, and black-hole quasi-normal-mode frequencies (GW150914: 0.5σ). UV completion pathways via asymptotic safety (Reuter 1998, UV fixed point g*=0.86) and the Planck lattice are identified. Three open problems are stated honestly: Hawking radiation, the full renormalisation programme, and the Standard Model matter sector. This is an unreviewed preprint submitted for community audit and replication.
